# XC Ski Masters

> > Comprehensive resource for masters-level cross-country ski racing, covering training methods, equipment reviews, and waxing techniques for age-group competitors.

Created by Rene Murmann, this site serves competitive masters Nordic skiers in Europe and North America with detailed guides on polarized training, equipment from brands like Atomic, Fischer, Salomon, and Madshus, and race preparation for events like the XC Ski Masters World Cup and major loppets.

## Key Topics

- Masters cross-country skiing
- Polarized training method
- V1 and V2 skate techniques
- Classic and skate ski waxing
- Racing equipment reviews (Atomic, Fischer, Salomon, Madshus)
- High-intensity interval training (HIIT)
- Low-intensity endurance training
- Lactate threshold training
- Skin skis (waxless technology)
- Grip wax application
- Age-group competition
- XC Ski Masters World Cup
- Recreational racing
- Nordic ski strength training

## Training Guides

- [Why the polarized training method works well for Nordic ski athletes](https://xcskimasters.com/polarized-training.html): Polarized training method for nordic skiers: intensity zones & periodization
- [High Intensity Interval Training for Endurance Athletes](https://xcskimasters.com/high-intensity-interval-training.html): HIIT training guide for XC skiers: zones, lactate threshold & intervals
- [Low intensity endurance training is the foundation to build your base](https://xcskimasters.com/low-intensity-endurance-training.html): Zone 1 training guide for building aerobic base in XC skiing
- [Nordic Ski Strength Training for The Competitive Ski Master](https://xcskimasters.com/nordic-ski-strength-training.html): Strength training guide for competitive masters XC skiers (V1/V2 techniques)

## Equipment & Gear Guides

- [Best cross country ski equipment for Masters competitors](https://xcskimasters.com/cross-country-ski-equipment.html): Comprehensive guide to XC ski equipment: sizing, bindings, boots & poles
- [The best skate skis for the recreational ski racer - a review](https://xcskimasters.com/best-skate-skis.html): Review of top racing skate skis from Atomic, Fischer, Madshus & Salomon
- [Best Cross Country Ski Poles for Nordic Ski Racing](https://xcskimasters.com/best-cross-country-ski-poles.html): Review of 7 top racing poles: KV+ Tornado, Swix Triac, Rex & more
- [Best skate ski boots – a review](https://xcskimasters.com/best-skate-ski-boots.html): Racing skate boot review: Alpina, Fischer, Madshus, Rossignol & Salomon
- [Skate Skis for Beginners to Advanced Skiers](https://xcskimasters.com/skate-skis-for-beginners.html): Review of 6 beginner-friendly skate skis including Atomic Pro S1
- [Classic Cross Country skis](https://xcskimasters.com/classic-cross-country-skis.html): Waxable classic race skis for marathons like Vasaloppet & Marcialonga

## Ski Waxing & Maintenance

- [Cross Country Ski Waxing for Ambitious Recreational XC Skiers](https://xcskimasters.com/cross-country-ski-waxing.html): Main ski waxing guide hub covering techniques for recreational racers
- [Skate Ski Wax Guide: Instructions to wax your skating skis](https://xcskimasters.com/skate-ski-wax-guide.html): Hot wax guide for skate skis: base prep, application & tools needed
- [A classic ski wax guide for enthusiastic XC skiers](https://xcskimasters.com/classic-ski-wax-guide.html): Classic ski waxing guide: grip wax application & glide zone preparation
- [Ski base structure application after hot waxing](https://xcskimasters.com/ski-base-structure.html): Ski base structuring guide: stone grinding vs manual structure tools
